messages:
alice.chen: Heads-up — dashboard shows available GPUs in us-east1 down from ~120 -> 48 since 04:00 UTC. Anyone else seeing this? We have the jenkins/canary loadtest scheduled 10:00 UTC tomorrow, need to know if we should move.
ben_ops: Yup seeing same. Vendor maintenance/rolling firmware — saw drain logged in VG-472. Infra is soft-limiting new allocations right now. @alice.chen if you can shift canary to us-west1 that's the lowest-friction option. :slightly_smiling_face:
carol-ml: If we move, can we automatically reduce batch_size to 4 for that job? Last time memory pressure spiked when we switched regions. cc @ben_ops
ben_ops: Yep — set env BATCH_SIZE=4 in the job spec and add allocation_zone=us-west1 to the terraform workspace for the canary. Quick check command if you want to confirm quotas: `gcloud compute regions describe us-east1 --format="value(quotas)"`
infra-bot: Vendor maintenance notice: vendor-dave scheduled rolling firmware, draining 72 GPUs in us-east1 between 03:45-06:15 UTC. Ticket VG-472.eta=2026-03-21T06:15:00Z
vendor-dave: Sorry for the churn — that's us. ETA ~90 mins to finish rolling firmware and return drained capacity. If you need faster, we can prioritize your tenant for an immediate patch if you attach the invoice ID to the ticket.
alice.chen: Ok thanks. I'll update the canary schedule to 11:30 UTC and set BATCH_SIZE=4 + allocation_zone=us-west1 for the run. Please ping when capacity is back to normal. :thumbsup:
